evidence.field: File description; summary and original-file link
evidence.text: The Commons description identifies 介-oracle.svg as a digitally created vector depicting 介 in Shang oracle-script style. It names Sinica and other databases as sources and links the Sinica 41.E3AC image. The page labels the image as an SVG redraw and supplies an original-file link; it is not an artifact photograph.
evidence.title: File:介-oracle.svg – Wikimedia Commons

evidence.text: The Commons file page states CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication for the redraw and says attribution is appreciated but not required. It also says the linked Sinica source image is under CC0 1.0.
evidence.title: File:介-oracle.svg – Wikimedia Commons

evidence.source: Academia Sinica, 小學堂字形資料庫
evidence.text: The official notice states that glyph images and glyph-attribute information obtained through the site's query interface are released under CC0 1.0 to the extent permitted by law.
evidence.title: 小學堂字形資料庫版權聲明

evidence.text: The page's original-file link resolved to https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/b9/%E4%BB%8B-oracle.svg?utm_campaign=index&utm_content=original&utm_source=commons.wikimedia.org, but the image fetch failed with a cache-miss error. This records the exact original URL established by the inspected page; image pixels were not visually inspected.

search_audit.outcome: Search located the 介 oracle Commons page and Sinica database homepage. Opened exact Commons pages, checked the oracle page's original-file link and licensing text, and opened Sinica's license notice. The seal image fetch and exact Sinica form record failed.

search_audit.query: "41.E3AC" 介 小學堂; "41.E3AC" 介 xiaoxue image; 介 oracle glyph image 41.E3AC
search_audit.outcome: Search results repeated the Commons form attribution but did not expose the specific Sinica record. A returned Unicode PDF was unrelated to this glyph and was not used.

gaps: Only the Commons oracle redraw is proposed. Its exact original image URL was established from the inspected description page, but the image request failed with a cache-miss error, so pixels were not visually inspected here.

The exact Xiaoxuetang 41.E3AC record failed to load. The Commons description page identifies it as the linked source image, and Sinica's official notice establishes CC0 terms for query-interface glyph images, but the specific form label and image could not be independently verified.

ACC-s00795.svg was unavailable in the fresh page and image attempts; the dossier's manifest lead is not used as provenance. The seal-style candidate's file page opened, but its original image fetch failed, so it is not selected.

items.period: Shang oracle-script style; modern vector redraw, not an artifact photograph
items.caption: A modern vector redraw labeled as 介 in Shang oracle-script style. Early forms are described as a person flanked by marks; the marks' meaning remains disputed.
items.alt: Vector redraw of an early 介 form, identified by Commons as Shang oracle-script style.
items.selection_reason: A character-specific Commons description page identifies the graph, names reference databases, links a Sinica source form, provides the exact original-file URL, and states CC0/public-domain reuse terms. Useful as an illustrative early-style candidate, with the caveat that this is a modern redraw and its pixels were not inspectable in this browser run.
items.rights: Commons page states CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication; attribution appreciated but not required.

limitations.text: The oracle redraw's direct image fetch failed with a cache-miss error, so visual inspection was not possible in this research pass.
The specific linked Sinica form record could not be opened; its label and pixels remain unverified, though the general query-image CC0 notice was inspected.
